cases.goal: Prove one component has one identity, version, digest, operationality, authority, and source of truth.
questions: What exact semantic responsibility does this component own?
Is it passive data or independently governed work?
What authority does it explicitly not possess?
What neighboring component is easiest to confuse with it?

cases.goal: Prove one pure operation executes as a deterministic logical Loop with typed lineage.
questions: What are the exact input and output contracts?
What native intrinsic implements the operation?
Is execution deterministic, idempotent, cacheable, and fusible?
Can the failed primitive be located from Run History?

cases.goal: Prove one model call receives a typed packet and cannot acquire execution authority.
questions: Is the original task immutable and separate from interpretation?
Are persona, task, Loop, intelligence, questions, capabilities, directive, and output contract distinct?
Does every selected block have a version and digest?
Can two provider adapters render the same logical packet?
adversarial_cases: rendered prompt becomes source of truth

cases.goal: Prove verification checks the user contract without silently adding a new acceptance contract.
questions: Which original acceptance criterion does each failure map to?
Is this a blocking defect or an advisory improvement?
What deterministic evidence supports the verdict?
Is the verifier independent from the producing route?

cases.goal: Prove continue, retry, repair, and stop decisions make measurable progress and cannot cycle forever.
questions: What exact state changed during the last pass?
Did the action produce novel evidence, a new artifact, or a new verified claim?
Does a repair bind an executable capability?
Has the same gap and method repeated beyond its budget?
Which terminal contract now applies?
adversarial_cases: same fetch repeated with different wording
later failure overwrites verified artifact state
pass budget exhausted without typed terminal reason

cases.goal: Prove roles, modes, relationships, layers, namespaces, functions, and capability groups remain orthogonal.
questions: Which one architectural axis does this label answer?
Is the item a Loop, passive component, capability, adapter, record, or projection?
Which persistent intelligence layer owns it?
Does its folder create a duplicate semantic authority?
